Instruction: the left tortoise remains substantially larger than the right with no meaningful reduction to match. Quality: coherent shells, heads, legs and claws, natural textures and contact shadows without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: bottle silhouette, red capsule and branded label remain; fine label artwork is slightly altered.
